latest_release.body:
## Security Advisories

- [GHSA-wh99-5qx8-cgh4](https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/security/advisories/GHSA-wh99-5qx8-cgh4)
- [GHSA-p39g-3xw6-83jx](https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/security/advisories/GHSA-p39g-3xw6-83jx)
- [GHSA-p398-cgqf-c48x](https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/security/advisories/GHSA-p398-cgqf-c48x)

## What's Changed

* ci: stop notifying retired downstream repos by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2110
* chore(nix): update prebuilt hashes for v0.80.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2109
* chore(deps): bump ureq from 3.4.1 to 3.4.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2113
* chore(deps): bump uuid from 1.26.1 to 1.28.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2114
* chore(deps): bump tokio from 1.53.1 to 1.53.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2116
* chore(deps): bump hyper from 1.11.1 to 1.12.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2117
* chore(deps): bump hyper-util from 0.1.20 to 0.1.21 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2115
* fix(proxy): use HTTP/1.1 for AWS intercept routes by @kurtisc in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2111
* feat(cli): skip approval requests for ungrantable procfs paths by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2054
* chore(deps): group routine Dependabot updates by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2119
* chore(deps): bump the routine-rust group with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2122
* feat(profiles): require fully qualified package profile names by @SequeI in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2118
* fix(ci): update cargo audit failures by @kurtisc in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2127
* Update maintainers list by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2137
* docs(readme): remove references to archived TypeScript and Go bindings by @kipz in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2138
* docs(readme): rewrite introduction and feature breakdown by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2139
* docs(neps): add NEP 0007 for remote supervisor decisions over vsock by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2150
* feat(linux): opt-in namespace isolation (NEP-0004) by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2145
* docs(cli): document network.listen_port_range in profiles-groups by @LuckVd in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2153
* fix(policy): enable Nix runtime and cache/channel access by @jpds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2151
* fix(policy): grant system_read_linux_core access to /var/lib/ca-certificates by @bharathvemula in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2149
* chore(release): automate NEP roadmap generation script and workflow by @lukehinds in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2144
* fix(proxy): resolve the Authorization phantom on token endpoint requests by @kipz in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2136
* fix(proxy): tolerate skew in certificates by @kurtisc in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2126
* chore(deps): bump dirs from 6.0.0 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2124
* chore(deps): bump jsonschema from 0.56.0 to 0.58.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2123
* fix(cli): keep --log-file output under --silent by @sreyas-endor in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2159
* chore(deps): bump the routine-rust group with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2162
* chore(deps): bump cachix/install-nix-action from 31.11.1 to 31.11.2 in the routine-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2161
* chore(deps): bump the sigstore group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/nolabs-ai/nono/pull/2160
* feat(policy): add `rtk_s
